card.name: Start of names and study codes
card.fires_on: Short pieces that begin a name or code in a citation or trial label, such as a first name, a letter after 'Study', or an initial in a reference list. Also punctuation inside ranges and citations.

modes.label: Study code letters
modes.description: A single capital letter opening a trial acronym after 'Study' or an open parenthesis.

modes.label: Names and citation punctuation
modes.description: A first name or punctuation mark in a reference or author list.
modes.example: Bielick, S., Chandler, K<<.,>> and Broughman, S.P.

modes.label: Dash in week ranges
modes.description: The dash between numbers in a dosing schedule table.
